title: רב חנא (או רב הונא) בגדתאה

paragraphs: Rav Chana, or Rav Huna, of Baghdad: named for his city Baghdad, the important city in Babylonia after Babylon's destruction—Rashi, Berakhot 54b; see Rav Hamnuna above. Another explanation is “master of aggadah”: Rashi, Yevamot 67a. He went up to Rav Yehudah: Berakhot 54b; end of HaMotze Tefillin, 95. He said to Rav Yehudah: Eruvin 81b, 95a. Shmuel's student: Shabbat 147b, near the end. Shmuel told him, “Bring me ten men, and I will tell you before them”: Yevamot 67a; Ketubot 7b; Zevachim 92a; Bava Batra 142b.
